skill.name: ai-video-generation
skill.description: Generate AI videos on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI — a smart router across the full video-model catalog: HappyHorse 1.0 (Arena #1, native in-pass audio), Wan-AI Wan 2-7 (open weights, audio-driven lip-sync), ByteDance Seedance v2 / 1-5 / 1-0 (multi-modal cinematic), Kling 3.0 / 2-6, Google Veo 3-1, MiniMax Hailuo 2-3, ByteDance Dreamina 3-0. Covers text-to-video (t2v), image-to-video (i2v), and Veo's video-extend endpoint. The skill picks the right model for the user's intent (Arena-#1 quality, multi-shot character identity, in-pass audio, cinematic motion, fastest path, sub-15s clip, longest duration) and ships each model's documented prompting patterns plus the minimal `runcomfy run` invoke. Triggers on "generate video", "make a video", "text to video", "t2v", "image to video", "i2v", "animate", "AI video", "make X move", "video from prompt", "video from image", or any explicit ask to produce a video clip from prompt or still.
skill.summary: Route AI video requests to RunComfy models and prepare CLI-ready generation prompts.
skill.author: agentspace-so

No executable Ruby backtick use, prompt-injection attempt, malicious filesystem access, or unauthorized network behavior was found in SKILL.md.

content.value_statement: Creating videos across many AI models requires careful endpoint and prompt selection. This skill routes each request to a RunComfy video model and prepares the matching CLI workflow.
actual_capabilities: Routes text-to-video requests to documented RunComfy model endpoints.
Routes image-to-video requests based on motion, realism, audio, and quality needs.
Provides model-specific prompt guidance for HappyHorse, Wan, Seedance, Kling, Veo, Hailuo, and Dreamina.
Prepares RunComfy CLI invocation patterns with expected input fields and output handling.
Explains when to use Veo extend workflows for longer or continued clips.
Documents security notes for tokens, trusted URLs, output downloads, and command scope.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and an authenticated RunComfy account.
Model availability, pricing, speed, and output quality depend on RunComfy services.
Reference media URLs are sent to an external model service for generation.
The skill guides generation but does not edit finished video files directly.

use_cases.title: Create Social Video Concepts
use_cases.description: Generate short vertical clips from prompts or still images for fast creative testing.

use_cases.title: Produce Product Motion Shots
use_cases.description: Animate product images with controlled motion, realistic camera direction, and stable object behavior.

use_cases.title: Prototype Narrative Scenes
use_cases.description: Compare models for character consistency, cinematic motion, lip sync, and longer video extension.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Text Video
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short clip from one idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an 8 second AI video of [subject] doing [main action] in [setting]. Use the best RunComfy text-to-video route and include audio guidance if supported.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Still Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Image-to-video request using a provided image URL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate this image: [image URL]. The subject should [motion]. Keep the camera [camera behavior], preserve identity, and choose the best RunComfy image-to-video model.

prompt_templates.title: Select the Right Video Model
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request comparing speed, cost, quality, and audio needs.
prompt_templates.prompt: I need a video for [goal]. Compare suitable RunComfy models for quality, speed, audio support, and realism, then recommend one route with a concise generation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Shot Campaign Clip
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with references, camera direction, and delivery constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production plan for a [duration] campaign video using [reference images or audio]. Preserve [identity or product details], use [visual style], include shot beats, and prepare the RunComfy route.

output_examples.input: Generate a vertical product teaser from a bottle photo with one slow rotation.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a Veo image-to-video route for realistic object motion, writes a concise motion prompt, and sets a vertical delivery target.

output_examples.input: Make a talking-head clip where a speaker matches my voiceover file.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends Wan 2-7 for audio-driven lip sync and separates scene description from the voiceover reference.

output_examples.input: Extend an existing Veo clip into a longer scene.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends the Veo extend route and describes how to preserve lighting, identity, and motion across the continuation.

best_practices: Describe one main action before adding style, camera, and audio details.
Use only reference media URLs that the user provided for the current task.
Start with faster or cheaper routes before generating final high-quality clips.
anti_patterns: Do not paste secrets, private tokens, or confidential scripts into generation prompts.
Do not mix many unrelated actions in one short clip request.
Do not use lip-sync routes when the audio track is not ready or user-approved.

faq.question: Does this skill create videos directly inside Claude or Codex?
faq.answer: No. It prepares and runs RunComfy CLI workflows for external video generation.

faq.question: Can it work from both text and images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill covers text-to-video, image-to-video, and selected video extension routes.

faq.question: Which model does it use by default?
faq.answer: It prefers HappyHorse for general text-to-video and image-to-video unless the request needs another model.

faq.question: Can it generate lip-synced dialog?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends Wan 2-7 when a specific voiceover file should drive mouth movement.

faq.question: Does it need network access?
faq.answer: Yes. RunComfy generation sends prompts and approved reference media to RunComfy model endpoints.

faq.question: How should I handle private media?
faq.answer: Use only media approved for external processing, and avoid prompts or URLs that expose secrets.
